mathematical_input.source_object: X_e on the tetrahedral edge star; only true box-boundary velocity nodes removed
mathematical_input.supported_object: Y_e on the one-face-neighbour patch; all exterior velocity nodes removed
mathematical_input.certified_statement: tau_e(ker sigma_e intersect Y_e) equals tau_e(ker gamma_e intersect X_e)

arithmetic.lower_rank_witness: selected full-rank minor modulo a prime

classification_definitions.incidence_type: one of seven coarse classes determined by edge increment, boundary incidence, and incident-tetrahedron count
classification_definitions.source_configuration: edge, star tetrahedra, and physical planes meeting the star, modulo integer translation and coordinate permutation
classification_definitions.coverage_configuration: source geometry plus the supported one-ring and every physical plane meeting it, modulo integer translation and coordinate permutation; reflections are not quotiented
classification_definitions.degree_record: one concrete (grid, geometric edge placement, polynomial degree) exact matrix computation
